rules.name: single-draw
rules.description: first draw: the new edge beat its matched weight-only nudge

rules.name: best-draw
rules.description: best new-edge draw gained more than the best weight-only draw

rules.name: median-paired
rules.description: median paired gain above 0 and the new edge won at least 6 of 8 draws

manifest.criteria: Primary test: holdout precision of median-paired minus best-draw; benefit iff the paired-bootstrap 95% CI lies above 0, harm iff below, else no-benefit. Secondary: median-paired minus single-draw, same criteria. Descriptive: the holdout distribution of medianPairedGain. A mutation is confirmed on a corpus iff its median paired gain there is above 0. Selection uses the cheap sample only.
manifest.paper: arXiv 2611.01213 — method not pinned; this is the repository's reading of the issue
